component: ESLint flat-config override order and Calendar test exceptions

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The repair places no-gviewwrapper-dbview before calendar-tests-use-utc. Both configure no-restricted-properties, and the Calendar block explicitly says it overrides the earlier list. The two test sites keep narrow line exceptions: TodayPane.setDay is a named receiver call, while new Date().getDate deliberately compares local and UTC dates for setup diagnostics. These exact exceptions do not establish a global Calendar lint exemption or a fresh lint result.
title: The Calendar UTC property list follows the generic dbView restriction
